{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "A slot the description says is not needed is not an item: give it worn false. One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with notch lapels, charcoal gray (#36454F), fine woven fabric.
An Oxford cotton shirt, relaxed but clean cut with a button-down collar, crisp white (#FFFFFF), soft poplin.
Wide-leg trousers with a subtle drape, high waistline, navy blue (#000080), heavy twill.
Polished leather ankle boots, rounded toe with a low block heel, deep chocolate brown (#4B3621), smooth calfskin.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an evening vocal lesson in the office, adhering to the "neat" dress code while respecting her specific wish for sneakers or similar casual footwear—here interpreted as comfortable, practical ankle boots that bridge the gap between professional polish and movement ease. The neutral tones of charcoal, navy, and white ensure she looks composed under artificial lighting without drawing excessive attention away from her voice performance. The natural fibers of wool, cotton, and leather provide warmth suitable for 18 °C autumn weather while maintaining a breathable comfort during active walking or singing exercises."}
